_status: DRAFT: AI-translated (Claude), not yet checked by a native Hausa speaker or agronomist. Diacritics/tone were not the concern here (Hausa's Latin script doesn't need them the way Yoruba/Igbo do), but agronomic word choice still needs a human check before this is marked reviewed.
rain_expected_delay_irrigation: An yi hasashen ruwan sama a cikin kwanaki 2 masu zuwa. Ku yi la'akari da jinkirta ban ruwa.
heavy_rainfall_risk: An yi hasashen ruwan sama mai yawa. Ku duba magudanan ruwa kuma ku guji aikin gona a lokacin da kasa take da ruwa sosai. Wannan hasashe ne, ba tabbaci ba.
heat_stress_risk: An yi hasashen zafi mai tsanani. Ku lura da amfanin gona don ganin ko yana yankwane, kuma ku duba dandanon kasa.
dry_spell_recent: Ba a sami isasshen ruwan sama ba a kwanan nan. Ku duba dandanon kasa kuma ku yi la'akari da ban ruwa idan akwai.
dry_spell_forecast: An yi hasashen fari. Ku duba dandanon kasa kuma ku yi la'akari da ban ruwa idan akwai.
high_water_demand_check_moisture: Amfanin gona yana bukatar ruwa mai yawa, kuma ba a hasashen ruwan sama mai yawa ba. Ku rika duba dandanon kasa akai-akai.
